title: Protocol for culturing and imaging ectodermal cells from Xenopus
author: Tejeda-Muñoz, Monka, et al.

steps.title: Dissect and dissociate animal caps
steps.instruction: Manually dechorionate Xenopus laevis embryos at blastula stages 8 or 9 with forceps, dissect the animal cap region in 1×MMR solution placed in plastic Petri dishes coated with 2 % agarose in H₂O, transfer explants to fresh 2 % agarose plates in 1×MMR, gently pipette up‑and‑down 3–4 times using a fire‑blunted glass Pasteur pipette (~1 mm opening) to dissociate cells while avoiding air exposure, and discard the more adherent pigmented epithelial cells.

steps.title: Prepare fibronectin‑coated coverslips
steps.instruction: Sterilize circular coverslips for a 12‑well plate by autoclaving or immersing in 70 % ethanol under a sterile hood, let ethanol evaporate, add 10 µg/mL fibronectin (Sigma F4759) to each well and incubate 30 min at 37 °C, then wash coverslips three times with PBS (Gibco).

substeps.instruction: Autoclave or ethanol‑sterilize coverslips; allow ethanol to evaporate.
Add 10 µg/mL fibronectin; incubate 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Plate dissociated cells
steps.instruction: Using a glass Pasteur pipette, plate the dissociated animal‑cap cells into L‑15 medium without serum diluted 1:1 with water (50 % L‑15) in a 12‑well culture dish containing the prepared fibronectin‑coated coverslips, adding cells from approximately 6 to 8 animal caps per well, and then add 1 mL of the 1:1 L‑15:H₂O medium to each well.

steps.title: Incubate cultured cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the plated cap cells at 15 °C–20 °C for 12–18 h, allowing individual ectodermal cells to divide and remain attached.

steps.title: Proceed with assay and treatments
steps.instruction: After incubation, carry out the chosen assay (live imaging, immunofluorescence, etc.) and treat cells with chemicals, growth factors, or drug treatments as required; animal‑cap dissociation can be accelerated using Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺‑free MMR or a 1:10 MMR mixture without divalent cations.

steps.title: Prepare SiR‑Lysosome stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve a SiR‑Lysosome vial in 50 µL anhydrous DMSO to obtain a 1 mM stock solution; the compound tolerates freeze‑thaw cycles, should not be aliquoted, and is stored at –20 °C (stable ≥3 months).

steps.title: Prepare TMR‑dextran 70 kDa stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 25 mg TMR‑dextran 70 kDa in 360 µL anhydrous DMSO to obtain a 1 mM stock solution; avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles and store aliquots at –20 °C for several weeks.

steps.title: Prepare 1× MMR solution
steps.instruction: Make 1× MMR (Marc’s Modified Ringers) containing 100 mM NaCl, 2 mM KCl, 2 mM CaCl₂, 1 mM MgCl₂, and 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4.
